name: DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Pill
description: Renders a pill-shaped badge as an SVG data URI with centered text

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Optional pill color. Defaults to Power BI theme color

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Pill' =
		(
			txt: STRING,
			color: STRING = BLANK(),
			width: INT64 = 120,
			height: INT64 = 48
		) =>

			VAR _Marks =
				DaxLib.SVG.Compound.Pill(
					0, 
                    0, 
                    width, 
                    height, 
                    txt, 
                    color
				)

			RETURN
				IF( NOT ISBLANK( _Marks ), DaxLib.SVG.SVG( "100%", "100%", _Marks, "0 0 " & width & " " & height ) )
